executiveSummary.headline: Turn Certified AI Presence Into Clearer Buyer Context
executiveSummary.lead: The Westin Monterrey Valle shows AI Consideration 27.1% and Scenario Presence 85.4% (peer #2 of 9) on the Dealality's latest AI visibility measurements. These measures do not diagnose a website defect. Priority work is to keep official facts accurate, document any automated-access constraints, and present demand-relevant strengths consistently for owners, GMs, and marketing teams.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration and Scenario Presence come from the Dealality's latest AI visibility measurements. Presence is not bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Certified Measurement Is the Baseline, Not a Website Verdict
themes.what: Consideration 27.1% / scenario 85.4% / peer #2 of 9 are retained from the certified ADP period without remeasurement.
themes.whyItMatters: Leadership should investigate visibility signals without treating the website as proven cause.

themes.title: Official Discovery Path Must Stay Accurate
themes.what: The official website did not return usable HTML to the automated probe; browser or brand-CDN confirmation may be required.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests, planners, and AI systems reuse official facts; broken or unreachable official pages undermine every recommendation.

themes.title: Destination and Partner Authority Is a Follow-On Opportunity
themes.what: Public partial Digital Authority research may identify destination inventories; unpaid research does not invent backlink counts.
themes.whyItMatters: Commercially relevant opportunities should be pursued only with verified pages and honest classifications.

priorities.action: Commercial team: approve canonical property facts on the official site
Digital/CDN owner: investigate automated access to the official site
Sales/marketing: identify one destination or partner listing opportunity
priorities.desiredOutcome: Qualified authority opportunity with official URL

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Official facts are approved and consistent; access constraints are documented if present; destination/partner opportunities are pursued without fabricated SEO metrics; future ADP periods can be compared without changing certified history.
executiveSummary.closing: The Westin Monterrey Valle should treat the certified AI measures as a monitoring signal. Improve factual clarity on the official site first, then pursue destination authority with verified links only.
